name: CosmicSingularity3D
_counts: Entity counts are PER GALAXY. World total = count x galaxies.length. stardustCount is nearly free per-tick because stardust is a STATIC layer (sent once on join, then deltas) - it only costs a bigger join payload. The others ride every 30 Hz snapshot, so raising them costs bandwidth linearly.
_galaxies: x,y is the CENTRE of the disc. arms+twist define the spiral geometry and MUST match the generator in visuals.js. seed only perturbs the painted star scatter.
